name: Mount Lofty House
insider_take: Perched 2,300 feet above sea level in the Adelaide Hills, this historic country estate offers breathtaking panoramic views stretching to the coast while maintaining the charm of its 1850s origins.
whats_special: Mount Lofty House sits on the same peak as the Mount Lofty Summit, South Australia's highest accessible point. The property features heritage-listed gardens designed by the same landscape architect who created Melbourne's Royal Botanic Gardens, and its Piccadilly Valley location places you in one of Australia's premier cool-climate wine regions.
pro_tip: Book a table at Hardy's Verandah Restaurant during sunset – the golden hour views over Adelaide and the coastline are absolutely spectacular, especially when paired with local Adelaide Hills wines.
dont_miss: The short walk to Mount Lofty Summit for 360-degree views, exploring the nearby Cleland Wildlife Park where you can cuddle koalas, and discovering the charming German-settled town of Hahndorf just 10 minutes away – Australia's oldest surviving German settlement with authentic cuisine and local artisan shops.
pros: Stunning Adelaide Hills location with panoramic city and mountain views
Historic manor house charm with modern luxury amenities
Award-winning Hardy's Verandah Restaurant with fine dining experience
Tranquil spa and wellness facilities in serene natural setting
cons: Secluded hilltop location requires car for city access
